deferred_work.required_next_action: TASK-3577 (done) built the concrete receipt-reader driver; supports()/compact() gate and event-record real, but no observable host receipt surface was found (status=failed, honest). AC11 remains open pending a follow-up spike with genuine interactive host access to find/prove a receipt-observation surface (Q1b), plus a real matched pilot meeting the documented thresholds -- this is intentionally not closed by decomposition alone.
